data.description: You invigorate your allies, who can hustle (Core Rulebook 170) as long as you continue to sing or chant (which requires your concentration). This movement counts as a walk (not a hustle) for the purpose of accruing nonlethal damage and fatigue. You can concentrate on this spell and hustle at the same time.

raw_tokens.value: Allies can hustle without penalty while you sing or chant.|!PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
